title: Certified Angus Beef® Jalapeno Beef Poppers
description: Crispy on the outside, these jalapeno-beef poppers are filled with gooey cheese and tender, juicy, Certified Angus Beef® chuck on the inside.
ingredients: 2 pounds Certified Angus Beef® ground chuck
12 ounces Food Club® Shredded Sharp Cheddar cheese
1 tablespoon Food Club® Pure Ground Black Pepper
1 cup Food Club® Plain Bread Crumbs
1 cup Food Club® Plain Panko Bread Crumbs

steps.text: Combine ground beef, cheese, jalapenos, salt, pepper, and mustard seeds in a large mixing bowl. Portion by hand into 42 "popper"-shaped balls, approximately 1 ounce each.
Crack and whisk eggs; put in a shallow dish. Combine bread crumbs and put in a second shallow dish.
Prepare a pot with frying oil; heat to 325 degrees F. Roll poppers in egg mix, 6 to 8 at a time. Roll in bread crumbs; repeat. Deep fry 4 minutes in batches. Allow to dry on paper towels.
